name: Killarney in a day
description_md:
This one day city sightseeing walk is anchored in Killarney. The route covers 12.1 km of walking between stops and takes about 7.6 hours for the full day.

The duration includes the visit time at each stop. Walkers navigate between five sightseeing stops along the path.
